description: The gate, first in report-only mode. A named step in the required core aggregate downloads the fast junit artifact and computes: (a) summed time over tests present in both baseline and PR; (b) summed time of tests not in the baseline, with an allowance of T1_BUDGET_SECONDS (0.5 s) x their count; (c) intersection coverage (warn under 95% of baseline ids); and the same comparison for each medium shard's existing junit. It writes a table and the would-be verdict (threshold +15% AND +60 s on summed intersection time) to the job summary, plus report-only pytest-wall and job-wall deltas. It never fails core in this item. A repo-committed policy file (enabled, mode report|block, thresholds) mirrors the fast-lane policy pattern and is the kill switch. Update docs/operations/fast-lane-budget.md (its claim that timeout-minutes bounds the lane's cost is not a detection mechanism) and add a changelog.d fragment.
